Scope and limits

What this forecast can and cannot show

  • 1
    Cases move drivers, not the structureThe moderate and severe cases change sales, margin and rates. The debt stack is the FY2026 one.
  • 2
    The base path is partialRevenue and margin are stated for FY2027 only. Capital spending and maturities are stated for each forecast year.
  • 3
    Covenant levels are not drawnThe limits sit in Legal & covenants. The path shows leverage only.
  • 4
    One leverage basisNet debt / EBITDA here uses adjusted EBITDA and FY2026 net debt held for FY2027.
